summary: The Junior Big Data Engineer supports the development and maintenance of data pipelines and big data platforms under the guidance of senior engineers.
responsibilities: Assist in building and maintaining data pipelines
Perform data validation and quality checks
Learn and apply best practices in big data engineering
Collaborate with team members on data projects

education: Bachelor’s degree or final-year student in a relevant field

skills_required.name: Basic knowledge of Python, Java, or Scala
Familiarity with SQL and data concepts
Exposure to Hadoop or Spark is a plus
